notes.value: BYD Seal, two Pakistan trims. Dynamic (headline figures): 61.44 kWh Blade LFP battery, single 150 kW / 310 Nm rear motor, 0–100 km/h in 7.5 s, 510 km NEDC, 110 kW CCS2 DC charging, kerb weight 1,922 kg, 225/50 R18 tyres, faux-leather seats; PKR 14,790,000. Premium: 82.56 kWh, 230 kW / 360 Nm rear motor, 5.9 s, 650 km NEDC, 150 kW DC, kerb weight 2,055 kg, 235/45 R19 tyres, ventilated and drilled discs with fixed front calipers, leather seats, driver-seat memory with lumbar adjustment, head-up display and FSD dampers; PKR 16,990,000. Both trims have 7 kW Type 2 AC charging, V2L, front, side, curtain and driver far-side airbags, a 15.6-inch rotating screen, a 50 L front trunk and a 400 L rear boot, and measure 4,800 × 1,875 × 1,460 mm on a 2,920 mm wheelbase. BYD Pakistan quotes 30–80% DC charging in 30 minutes without naming a trim, so no charge time is stored. The 3.8 s on byd-mega.com is the AWD Performance, which is not sold in Pakistan. Prices are ex-factory and unchanged after Budget 2026-27. Top speed (180 km/h) and ground clearance are not in BYD Pakistan material. Sources: BYD Pakistan Seal spec sheet (byd-mega.com), byd-mega.com/vehicles/seal, ProPakistani (12 Jun 2026), PakWheels price list, PakNEV.
